description: One entry of the ERP weekly shift pattern (`/api/calendar` -> `week_pattern`): department x ISO weekday x shift, with the working-time window and its breaks. Full text: docs/history/standard/profiles/operations/shift-window.md, description.

properties.name: shift_window_id
properties.description: Identity of the shift window: its own number from the source system (ISA-95 WorkCalendarEntry.ID; core 4.0.0 — before, the key was composed of department, weekday and shift).

properties.name: department_id
properties.description: Department the window belongs to. Measured population 2026-08-03: LAGER | MECH | MONTAGE | SG. NOT declared as an enum: the plant may add a department without a schema change, and a consumer must never treat an unknown department as 'not scheduled'. Part of the composite key.

properties.name: day_of_week
properties.description: ISO-8601 weekday, 1=Monday .. Full text: docs/history/standard/profiles/operations/shift-window.md, attributes › day_of_week › description.

properties.name: shift_id
properties.description: Shift code as the ERP names it. Full text: docs/history/standard/profiles/operations/shift-window.md, attributes › shift_id › description.

properties.name: start_time
properties.description: Window start on the PLANT CLOCK as HH:MM:SS. No date and no timezone — this is a weekly pattern, not an instant. A consumer applies it in the same clock it attributes buckets in (golden-shift: tzOffsetMinutes, default 0 = UTC).

properties.name: end_time
properties.description: Window end on the plant clock as HH:MM:SS. Full text: docs/history/standard/profiles/operations/shift-window.md, attributes › end_time › description.

properties.name: break_minutes
properties.description: Unpaid break minutes inside the window. Full text: docs/history/standard/profiles/operations/shift-window.md, attributes › break_minutes › description.

properties.name: work_calendar_definition_ref
properties.description: The WorkCalendarDefinition this pattern entry belongs to (PART_OF; ISA-95 Part 4 cl. 13, B2MML WorkCalendarDefinition.WorkCalendarDefinitionEntry). Optional.

properties.name: parent_shift_window_ref
properties.description: The ShiftWindow this ShiftWindow is part of (PART_OF; ISA-95 WorkCalendarEntry MADE_UP_OF WorkCalendarEntry). Optional.

isa95.note: One entry of the plant's weekly shift pattern = a WorkCalendarDefinitionEntry (ISA-95 Part 4 cl. 13): a recurring rule, not a dated entry (OPEN-0350 round 4, Q3). Full text: docs/history/standard/profiles/operations/shift-window.md, isa95 › note.
isa95.grain: one entry of the plant's weekly shift pattern, a WorkCalendarDefinitionEntry (ISA-95 Part 4 cl. 13; B2MML-WorkCalendar.xsd WorkCalendarDefinitionEntryType): one row = one shift on one weekday (day_of_week, shift_id, start_time, end_time), keyed by shift_window_id
isa95.mappingNote: B2MML WorkCalendarDefinitionEntry has no break time (the weekday is its RecurrenceTime). Self-nesting and containment are PART_OF on the child with a reference to the parent (B2MML nests the child inside the parent).
